	def getAttr(attributeName, defaultValue=None, inherit=True):
		attrRow = attributes.get(attributeName) or {}
		rawValue = attrRow.get('assetAttrValue')
	
		if rawValue is not None: assetAttrValue = system.util.jsonDecode(rawValue)
		elif inherit: assetAttrValue = system.util.jsonDecode(system.kanoa.asset.getClosestAncestorAttribute(assetPath, attributeName))
		else: assetAttrValue = defaultValue
	
		if assetAttrValue is None: assetAttrValue = defaultValue
	
		hasLocalAttr = attrRow.get('assetAttrId') is not None
	
		if value['parentId'] is None: inherited = False
		elif not inherit: inherited = False
		else: inherited = not hasLocalAttr

#		system.perspective.print("%s parentId=%s attrRow=%s hasLocalAttr=%s inherited=%s" % (attributeName, value.get('parentId'), attrRow, hasLocalAttr, inherited))
		return {'assetAttrId': attrRow.get('assetAttrId'), 'inherited': inherited, 'value': assetAttrValue}

	# _ProductionDay
	attr = getAttr('_ProductionDay', {'startTime': 0, 'endTime': 0})
	attrs['_ProductionDay'] = {'inherited': attr['inherited'], 'assetAttrId': attr['assetAttrId'], 'startTime': str(attr['value']['startTime']).zfill(4), 'endTime': str(attr['value']['endTime']).zfill(4)}
	
	# _assetOEEStateDisplay

	# _showOnMainDisplay
	attr = getAttr('_showOnMainDisplay', (value.get('assetTypeName') or '').lower() == 'line', inherit=False)
	attrs['_showOnMainDisplay'] = {'assetAttrId': attr['assetAttrId'], 'value': bool(attr['value'])}
	
	# _oeeThreshold
	attr = getAttr('_oeeThreshold', {'oee': 0.6, 'a': 0.8, 'p': 0.8, 'q': 0.8, 'oeeTolerance': 0.1, 'aTolerance': 0.1, 'pTolerance': 0.1, 'qTolerance': 0.1})
	
	threshold = attr['value']
	
	if threshold.has_key('targetThreshold'):
		threshold['oeeTolerance'] = threshold['targetThreshold']
		threshold['aTolerance'] = threshold['targetThreshold']
		threshold['pTolerance'] = threshold['targetThreshold']
		threshold['qTolerance'] = threshold['targetThreshold']

		'qTolerance': float(threshold['qTolerance'])
	}

messageHandlers.script:
system.perspective.print('assetImportUpdate message rcvd with %s'%payload)
	
	mode = payload['mode']
	assetId = payload['assetId']
	overwrite = payload['overwrite']
	newAssetName = payload['newPath'].split('\\')[-1]
	
	if payload['oldPath'] != payload['newPath']:
		system.perspective.print('Updating assetPath')
		newParts = []
		oldParts = []
		
		newSplit = payload['newPath'].split('\\')
		oldSplit = payload['oldPath'].split('\\')
		
		pathSplitter = '**|**'
		pathBackSlash = '\\\\'
		
		eData = str(system.util.jsonEncode(self.custom.data))
		eData = eData.replace(pathBackSlash, pathSplitter)
		
		for i in range(len(oldSplit)):
			newParts.append(newSplit[i]) 
			oldParts.append(oldSplit[i])
			
			newName = newParts[-1]
			oldName = oldParts[-1]
			
			newPath = pathSplitter.join(newParts[:-1] + [newName])
			oldPath = pathSplitter.join(newParts[:-1] + [oldName])
			
			system.perspective.print("Replacing %s with %s"%(oldPath, newPath))
			eData = eData.replace('"assetPath":"%s'%oldPath, '"assetPath":"%s'%newPath)			
			
			if oldName != newName:
				system.perspective.print("Replacing %s with %s"%(oldName, newName))
				eData = eData.replace('"assetName":"%s"'%oldName, '"assetName":"%s"'%newName)
	
		eData = eData.replace(pathSplitter, pathBackSlash)
		
		data = system.util.jsonDecode(eData)
	else:
		data = self.custom.data
	
	self.saveImport(mode, data, assetId, newAssetName, overwrite)
	
	return

customMethods.name: deleteAssets
customMethods.script:
assetInfo = self.view.custom.assets.selectedAssetInfo
	assetId = assetInfo['assetId']
	parentId = assetInfo['parentId']
	assetPath = assetInfo['assetPath'] or 'None'	#Just to prevent us deleting all tags
	if assetId is None: return	
	
	system.perspective.print("deleteAssets() called for %s"%assetId)	
	userId = self.session.custom.kanoa.security.userId

	assetTagPaths = [row['tagPath'] for row in system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetPath': assetPath + '%', 'oeeEnabled': True}) if row['tagPath'] is not None]
	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.asset.deleteAssets(assetId, userId)
	if msg is None: 
		self.deleteAssetTags(assetTagPaths)	#We'll need to get all assets that were deleted and delete their tag structure
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'success', 'message': 'Asset(s) have been deleted'})
	else:
		error = str(msg).split(":")[-1]
		environment = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('configValue', system.kanoa.config.getConfig({'configTypeName': 'application', 'configName': 'environment'})) or ''
		
		if environment.lower() == 'production':
			msg = "%s We restrict the deletion of production assets with data in a production environment. You can disable the asset(s), or if you still want to delete them, switch this gateway configuration to 'development' environment, or execute the stored procedure mes.spDeleteAssetsWithForce directly on the database."%error
			system.perspective.openPopup('info', 'kanoa/core/templates/displays/messagePopup', {'text': msg}, title='Warning', draggable=True, resizable=True)
		else:
			msg = "%s Deleting %s will also delete the historical data. This cannot be undone. Do you wish to continue?"%(error, assetInfo['assetName'])
			system.perspective.openPopup('userDeleteConfirm', 'kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm', {'text':msg, 'messageHandler':'deleteAssetHistory', 'inputPayload': {'assetId': assetId}}, title='Warning', draggable=True, resizable=True)
		return

	self.selectAsset(None)
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.assets.data")
	system.perspective.sendMessage('clearTreeSelection', {})

	self.view.refreshBinding('custom.assets.data')

	return

	if assetId is None: return

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.assets.data")

customMethods.script:
#Saves the attribute changes and returns (how many changed, what failed), for the caller's one toast: it toasted each
	#attribute itself, so a Save showed a toast per attribute and then another (868mvvzbz)
	system.perspective.print("saveAssetAttributes() called")	
	attrList = self.view.custom.customAttributes.list or []
	userId = self.session.custom.kanoa.security.userId
	changed = 0
	failures = []
		
	for attr in attrList:
		if attr.state == 'drop': continue
		if attr.state == 'delete': 
			deleted = system.kanoa.asset.deleteAssetAttribute(attr['attrId'], userId)
			if deleted is None: failures.append("couldn't delete %s" % attr['label'])
			else: changed += 1
			
		elif attr.state in ('insert', 'update'):
			system.perspective.print("calling addAssetAttribute() with %s %s %s %s"%(assetId, attr['label'], attr['text'], userId))
			#(assetAttributeId, 'Added' or 'Updated'); no id when it failed
			result = system.kanoa.asset.addAssetAttribute(assetId, attr['label'], attr['text'], userId)
			if result is None or result[0] is None: failures.append("couldn't save %s%s" % (attr['label'], (': %s' % result[1]) if result is not None and result[1] else ''))
			else: changed += 1

	return changed, failures

customMethods.name: updateAssetSortOrder
customMethods.script:
#The parent's children in the order the tree shows them (siblingPaths, their asset paths); any it doesn't list keep their order after them
	assets = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'parentId': parentId}))
	byPath = dict((asset['assetPath'], asset['assetId']) for asset in assets)
	order = [byPath[path] for path in (siblingPaths or []) if path in byPath]
	order += [asset['assetId'] for asset in assets if asset['assetId'] not in order]
	for i, assetId in enumerate(order):
		self.updateAssetField(assetId, 'sortOrder', i, self.session.custom.kanoa.security.userId)
	
	return

	self.view.custom.assets.data = None

messageHandlers.script:
system.perspective.print("refreshAssets msg rcvd with payload %s"%(payload))
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.assets.data")
	
	return

system.perspective.print("deleteAssetHistory msg rcvd with payload %s"%(payload))
	if payload.has_key('userInput') and payload['userInput'] == 'OK':
		assetId = payload['inputPayload']['assetId']
		self.deleteAssetsWithForce(assetId)
	
	return

#The tree selector's drop: draggedItem is the asset dragged, droppedItem its new parent (None at the top level) and
	#siblingIds the new parent's children (asset paths) in their new order
	assetPath = payload['draggedItem']['assetPath']
	if assetPath is None: return
	
	if not self.view.custom.userAction.canCreate:
		system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'warning', 'message': 'User action not allowed'})
		self.resetTree()
		return
			
	draggedItem = payload['draggedItem']
	droppedItem = payload['droppedItem'] if payload['droppedItem'] is not None else {'parentId': None, 'assetId': None, 'assetPath': 'root level'}
	
	if draggedItem['parentId'] == droppedItem['assetId']:
		#Reordered under the same parent: save the order the tree shows
		self.updateAssetSortOrder(draggedItem['parentId'], payload['siblingIds'])
		self.view.refreshBinding('custom.assets.data')
		self.selectAsset(draggedItem['assetId'])
	else:
		#A new parent, even a sibling of the same type (868mu1gtd: that was taken for a reorder, so nothing was saved)
		assetPath = system.kanoa.utilities.formatPath(assetPath, {})
		parentPath = system.kanoa.utilities.formatPath(droppedItem['assetPath'], {})
		msg = "Are you sure you want to move %s to %s"%(assetPath, parentPath)
		system.perspective.openPopup('moveAsset', 'kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm', {'text':msg, 'messageHandler':'confirmMoveAsset', 'inputPayload': {'draggedItem': draggedItem, 'droppedItem': droppedItem}}, title='Move Asset?', draggable=True)
	
	return

draggedItem = payload['inputPayload']['draggedItem']
	droppedItem = payload['inputPayload']['droppedItem']
	
	moved = False
	if payload['userInput'] == 'OK':
		assetName = draggedItem['assetName'] if draggedItem.has_key('assetName') else draggedItem['assetPath']
		try:
			assetInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetId': draggedItem['assetId']}),0)
			assetInfo['parentId'] = droppedItem['assetId'] if droppedItem is not None else None
			#The user from the session, as the rest of this view: it has no custom.security, and reading it failed the move (868mu1gtd)
			retVal, msg = system.kanoa.asset.updateAsset(assetInfo, self.session.custom.kanoa.security.userId)
		except Exception as e:
			retVal, msg = None, str(e)
		if msg: system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'error', 'message': 'Couldn\'t move asset "%s": %s' % (assetName, msg)})
		else:
			moved = True
			system.kanoa.toast.show({'type': 'success', 'message': 'Asset "%s" moved' % assetName})

	self.selectAsset(None)
	system.perspective.sendMessage('clearTreeSelection', {})
	if moved:
		self.view.custom.assets.refreshTree = True
		self.view.refreshBinding('custom.assets.data')
	else:
		#Not moved (cancelled or refused): the tree still shows the drop, so put it back
		self.resetTree()
	
	return

uuid = payload['uuid']
	attrId = payload['attrId']
	state = payload['state']
	label = payload['label']
	text = payload['text']
	
	for item in self.view.custom.customAttributes.list:
		if item.uuid == uuid:
			item.state = state
			item.label = label
			item.text = text
			break
	else:
		self.view.custom.customAttributes.list.append({
			"attrId": attrId,
			"label": label,
			"text": text,
			"options": [],
			"uuid": uuid,
			"state": state
		})
		
	return

system.perspective.print("addGroup() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	if (payload['label'] or None) is None: return
	
	system.kanoa.asset.addAssetGroup(payload['label'], self.session.custom.kanoa.security.userId)

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.assetGroups")
	
	return

system.perspective.print("editGroup() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	if (payload['label'] or None) is None: return
	
	system.kanoa.asset.updateAssetGroup(payload['label'], self.view.custom.assets.selectedAssetInfo.assetGroupId, self.session.custom.kanoa.security.userId)

	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.assetGroups")
	
	return

system.perspective.print("deleteGroup() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	
	if payload.has_key('userInput') and payload['userInput'] == 'OK':	
		self.deleteGroup()
	
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.assetGroups")
	
	return

text = payload['text'] if payload.has_key('text') else ''
	infoType = payload['infoType'] if payload.has_key('infoType') else 'INFO'
	showBar = True if text else False
	
	self.view.custom.info = {"showBar": showBar, "text": text, "type": infoType}
